descriptions.zh-Hans: 在内罗毕吃过玉米团后做的纸菜单，盘沿留着几个缺口。
descriptions.en: My paper menu after ugali in Nairobi, showing the gaps round my serving.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我记下那次烤肉午饭的小菜单，夹子终于摆在盘边。
descriptions.en: A little record of my roast-meat lunch, with the tongs finally resting beside the plate.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把卡鲁拉那次指路的两只手折成纸角，只记自己的小失误。
descriptions.en: My folded paper corner remembers two hands pointing different ways in Karura.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 参观鸟类展厅后剪的两双纸鞋尖，都是站平的样子。
descriptions.en: Two pairs of paper toes cut after the bird gallery visit, with both pairs flat on the ground.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在内罗毕自己做的折页，张开双手大小的圈，合上只剩一只小碗。
descriptions.en: My Nairobi foldout opens into a large hand gesture and closes around one small bowl.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸卡，小窗里是个人约定的编号，不用作森林地图。
descriptions.en: My homemade card has a little window for a meeting number, rather than a usable forest map.
